verdict.rationale: Ramp documents autonomous background behavior. Its in-product agents work "around the clock," scanning transactions in real time, coding expenses, and approving when safe. It also auto-rebooks hotels on price drops and sends reminders automatically. Admins can configure rules-based workflows and auto-approve policies, and agents.ramp.com offers long-running access for background agents that run on a schedule, with the CLI positioned for scripted and scheduled workflows. missing for 10: a native general-purpose automation builder or scheduler (scheduled agents must run on the user's own runtime via CLI/API), in-depth docs on configuring custom autonomous workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
